dct_title_s: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) Local Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: République démocratique du Congo (RDC), Réseau routier local Lines + Polygons : Local roads Interactive Online Map [OSM Roads](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway) Columns: osm_id, highway, name, layer, bridge, tunnel, oneway, ref , route, junction, lanes, width, maxspeed, surface, practicability, smoothness, condition, geometry OSM Filter highway in ('residential', 'living_street', 'path', 'footway', 'pedestrian', 'steps', 'cycleway', 'track', 'service', 'bridleway', 'construction', 'road') * highway=road attribute for roads not yet classified. The Major Roads dataset is available from the [Major Roads network dataset](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/democratic-republic-of-congo-drc-major-roads-network-openstreetmap-export)
